description: How often a connected source syncs, per data type (costs, events, usage): the effective rate, the default, and the choices with whether this plan may take each (faster rates need a paid plan; `fast_sync_enabled` says whether it does). Mirrors GET /api/accounts/:accountId/sync-cadence/:sourceId. Change a rate with set_sync_cadence.

source_id.description: The connected source, for example "gcp" or "github"

name: get_sync_cadence
